bio_en: Kūkai (774–835), born in Sanuki, travelled to Tang China in 804. At Qinglong Monastery in Chang'an he received the Vajra Realm and Womb Realm transmissions from Huiguo in 805, returning to Japan the following year. He established the Shingon tradition and obtained permission to found a monastic centre at Mount Kōya in 816. He also directed esoteric Buddhist activities at Tōji in Kyoto. His Treatise on the Ten Stages of Mind sets out a classification of Buddhist and non-Buddhist teachings.
bio_summary: 讚岐人，804 年隨遣唐使入唐，805 年於長安青龍寺盡受惠果兩部大法，806 年歸國開真言宗（東密），816 年開高野山；奉淳和天皇敕撰《十住心論》十卷，立十住心判教，攝顯密於一綱。
